text:
alex: Quick sync  planning a short hotfix at 11:30 PDT for emoji tokenization affecting /generate. Need RN snippet, internal announce, and rollback lanes.
maria: Draft RN: "Deploying v3.1.3-hotfix to fix tokenization for certain emoji sequences in /generate and /chat. Targeted fix, no downtime expected. If you see odd characters, contact support."
tim: Ops rollback lanes:
- A: revert images to :3.1.2
- B: shift traffic to standby region + disable canary
Keep alert thresholds: error>2% for 5m or p95>2x.
jen: Internal announce short: "Hotfix rollout v3.1.3-hotfix at 11:30 PDT. Oncall: robert-oncall. See RN link."
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex at 2026-05-02T18:30:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 6178123456`.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started. Health checks OK. Traffic 10% canary.
jen: I'll post announcement once we hit 50%.
maria: RN posted: https://internal/docs/rn/v3.1.3-hotfix. Includes pin commands and rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. All checks passed.
alex: Thanks everyone. Keeping monitoring window open for 30m; will file postmortem only if we see issues.
